description: This file defines the exported APIs for an SNMP plugin, including initialization, support check, unload, and memory management functions, with licensing and module information.

methods.name: COSA_Init
methods.description: Initializes the SNMP plugin with maximum supported version and plugin info.

methods.name: COSA_Async_Init
methods.description: Performs asynchronous initialization of the SNMP plugin.

methods.name: COSA_IsObjectSupported
methods.description: Checks if a given object name is supported by the plugin.

methods.name: COSA_Unload
methods.description: Unloads or cleans up the plugin.

methods.name: COSA_MemoryCheck
methods.description: Performs a memory check related to the plugin.

methods.name: COSA_MemoryUsage
methods.description: Reports memory usage of the plugin.

methods.name: COSA_MemoryTable
methods.description: Manages or reports the plugin's memory table.
